findings.body: The title says "Add a helper for shortening model-authored text" and the body only describes `findings::summarise`, but the diff also adds a MongoDB kernel-bypass shim (`deploy/mongo/kernel-bypass-entrypoint.py`), a docker-compose overlay (`docker-compose.kernel-bypass.yml`), an `[embeddings]` block in `.tinysweeper.toml`, and renames the GitHub auth env vars from `TINYSWEEPER_GITHUB_*` to `TINYSWEEPER_APP_*` with `:?` required-value semantics. A reviewer reading only the description would miss that the compose file now requires `TINYSWEEPER_APP_ID` and `TINYSWEEPER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` or it will refuse to start — a breaking change for any existing deployment that set the old names.
findings.existing_code:
TINYSWEEPER_APP_ID: ${TINYSWEEPER_APP_ID:?set the GitHub App id}
      TINYSWEEPER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${TINYSWEEPER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY:?set the GitHub App private key}
findings.title: Mention deployment changes in the PR description

value.summary: The PR adds a text-shortening helper as described, but the diff also includes significant deployment infrastructure changes — a MongoDB kernel-bypass entrypoint, a docker-compose overlay, embeddings config, and GitHub auth env-var renames — none of which the title or body mention. The code itself looks sound.
